Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.173 of 2022, under Section 363, 376, 506 IPC & Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, P.S. Dargah Shareef, District Bahraich.
3. In terms of the FIR lodged as a missing person report, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant.
Subsequently, in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that she had gone alongwith the applicant to Rajkot and thereafter, they stayed as husband and wife.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also, she stated that she had gone alongwith the applicant to Rajkot.
The tentative age of the victim as per the educational certificate is 16 years, 5 months, 11 days.

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the two statements which do not support the prosecution story coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and in custody since 22.06.2023, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pappu Alias Wassem be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
